description: Make direct-Agent AgentSessions queryable, summarizable, and attributable across the server read model, HTTP API, and CLI — without introducing a new AgentTask read model.

tasks.title: Index agent-launch labels as queryable computed columns
tasks.description: Add 6 stored computed columns to AgentSessionRow and MohistDbContext.AgentSessions (LabelAgentId, LabelAgentName, LabelAgentLaunchIssueNumber, LabelAgentLaunchEpicNumber, LabelAgentLaunchRepository, LabelAgentLaunchWorkspacePath) mirroring the existing json_extract(State,'$.metadata.labels."…"') pattern, plus a composite (LabelAgentId, LabelProjectId, CreatedAt) index and single-column indexes on the issue/epic number columns. Ship a new EF Core migration using the established add-nullable-then-AlterColumn-to-stored-computed table-rebuild pattern. Extend AgentSessionQuery.QueryRowsByLabels with 6 switch cases mapping the GenericAgentSessionMetadata key constants to the new columns; the 8 existing workflow-shaped keys stay byte-identical.
acceptanceCriteria: Querying by mohist.io/agent-id returns only that agent's generic agent-launch sessions and excludes other agents and workflow-shaped sessions
Querying by mohist.io/agent-name resolves to the same set as the agent-id query without requiring the caller to know the id
Querying by each of the four agent-launch/* context-ref labels (issue-number, epic-number, repository, workspace-path) matches sessions via the indexed columns, not a no-match fallback
The existing 8 workflow-shaped lookup keys (project-id, source-id, session-name, work-id, work-type, stage, issue-number, etc.) resolve exactly as before this change
The new EF migration applies cleanly against the in-memory SQLite integration fixture and derives all column values from existing State JSON (no data backfill)
Unit specs using the FakeDbContextFactory on SqliteConnection(":memory:") pattern cover each new label key and a workflow-key regression
tasks.output: Updated AgentSessionRow.cs and MohistDbContext.cs, a new EF migration file, extended QueryRowsByLabels switch in AgentSessionQuery.cs, and focused unit specs.
tasks.notes: Foundation task; every downstream read path consumes the indexed label columns and the shared GenericAgentSessionMetadata key constants. Reference both the switch cases and the computed-column SQL to those constants to prevent drift.

tasks.title: Agent-scoped session list query with status filter
tasks.description: Add an agent-scoped list method to AgentSessionQuerier (e.g. ListAgentSessionsAsync(projectId, agentId, statusSet, limit)) that composes labels (project-id, agent-id, source-kind=agent-launch), is ordered by recency, and is capped. Resolve terminal status per session by reusing LoadTerminalFactsAsync; map 'running' to opened + no terminal fact + AgentSessionId present; apply the requested status set (running/completed/failed/stopped) as an in-memory filter over the indexed result set so it combines with context-reference filters.
acceptanceCriteria: The list returns only the resolved agent's generic agent-launch sessions, recency-ordered and capped at the requested limit
A status filter restricts results to matching sessions and is combinable with context-reference filters so sessions matching only one filter are excluded
The workbench four groupings (recent / running / failed / ended) are derivable from the list output and a session appears in exactly one primary state grouping
The query does not leak workflow sessions or another agent's sessions
Unit specs cover each status value, multi-status combination, the running mapping, and a context+status combination
tasks.output: New ListAgentSessionsAsync method on AgentSessionQuerier plus unit specs.
tasks.notes: The DB query does the heavy lifting on the indexed columns from T-001; terminal status is resolved in-memory via LoadTerminalFactsAsync to avoid coupling the write path to a derived status column.

tasks.title: Generic AgentSession summary read model
tasks.description: Introduce GenericAgentSessionSummaryDto carrying agentId/agentName, status, created/lastActivity, resolved model, usage, failure category (when present), tool call/error counts, and an optional contextRefs envelope (issueNumber, epicNumber, repository, workspacePath). Add GetGenericSessionSummaryAsync building the DTO from FindGenericSessionAsync + LoadTranscriptAsync, reusing TranscriptEventSummaryProjector and AgentSessionJsonHelper. Retire GetGenericSessionMetadataAsync (its only caller is the route reshaped in T-005). Workflow-only fields (workflowRunId, sessionName, workId, workType, stage) are absent by construction, not nulled.
acceptanceCriteria: The summary carries agent id, agent name, status, created, last-activity, resolved model, usage, failure category (when present), tool call count, tool error count, and recorded context references
The summary never presents a fabricated workflow run id, session name, work id, work type, or stage; absent fields are omitted, not null
A sessionId that does not resolve to a generic agent-launch session in the project yields a clear not-found result and never returns a workflow session
GetGenericSessionMetadataAsync is removed and has no remaining callers
Unit specs cover the enriched fields, the absent-workflow-fields invariant, and the not-found path
tasks.output: GenericAgentSessionSummaryDto, GetGenericSessionSummaryAsync on AgentSessionQuerier, removal of GetGenericSessionMetadataAsync, and unit specs.
tasks.notes: Do not widen the existing AgentSessionMetadataDto — its structurally-required SessionName would have to be nulled, contradicting 'absent rather than null'. Use a dedicated DTO.

tasks.title: Attribute generic sessions by agent in activity and active-agents readouts
tasks.description: Branch AgentSessionQuerier.ToActivityCard on source-kind=agent-launch to synthesize an agent_{agentId} identity and populate new optional AgentId/AgentName fields on ActivityCardDto instead of issue_{projectId}_0; a generic session with an issue ref still surfaces the issue number but is attributed to the Agent profile. Drop the blanket blank-workflowRunId/workId skip in WorkflowActivityQuerier.ListActiveAgentsAsync and emit an agent-attributed ActiveAgentDto (extend with optional AgentId/AgentName) with session-derived progress (degenerate TaskProgress or null) for generic active sessions. Workflow cards and entries remain byte-identical.
acceptanceCriteria: A generic agent-launch session activity card carries the agent id and agent name and is never attributed to an issue_{projectId}_0 / issue-number-zero card
A generic session with no issue reference produces no synthetic issue card and is attributable by agent identity alone
A generic session carrying an issue reference is associated with that issue but still attributed to its Agent profile
An active generic agent-launch session appears in the active-agents readout despite a blank workflowRunId/workId, attributed to its Agent profile without a workflow-derived work item
Workflow activity cards and workflow active-agent entries are unchanged in field values
Integration specs via MohistIntegrationFixture with seeded AgentSessionRow cover both readouts and the workflow regression
tasks.output: Updated ToActivityCard and ListActiveAgentsAsync, additive AgentId/AgentName on ActivityCardDto and ActiveAgentDto, and integration specs.
tasks.notes: New fields are nullable and stay null for workflow cards — additive only, no field removed or reordered. The existing activity endpoint needs no new route; it returns the fixed read model automatically.

tasks.title: Agent workbench read API: list, summary, and transcript routes
tasks.description: Extract the agentRef (agent_* id-else-name) resolution currently inline in AgentSessionLaunchRoutes into a shared AgentRefResolver used by launch and the new list endpoint. Register GET /api/projects/{projectRef}/agents/{agentRef}/sessions?status=&limit= returning the agent-scoped list. Reshape the existing GET /api/projects/{projectRef}/agent-sessions/{sessionId} route (already registered in AgentSessionFollowupRoutes) to return GenericAgentSessionSummaryDto. Add GET /api/projects/{projectRef}/agent-sessions/{sessionId}/transcript reusing the existing transcript query path without requiring a workflow run id or session name. Unknown agentRef/sessionId return 404 and never return a workflow session.
acceptanceCriteria: GET .../agents/{agentRef}/sessions returns 200 with recency-ordered generic sessions, each carrying session id, agent id, agent name, status, created, last-activity, and resolved model; honors ?status= and is distinct from the project-wide .../agent/sessions and the workflow .../issues/{n}/sessions lists
Unknown {agentRef} returns 404
GET .../agent-sessions/{sessionId} returns the enriched GenericAgentSessionSummaryDto; a non-generic or unknown sessionId returns 404 and never returns a workflow session
GET .../agent-sessions/{sessionId}/transcript returns the transcript and runtime events without requiring a workflow run id or session name; unknown sessionId returns 404
The existing issue-scoped GET .../issues/{number}/sessions/{name} route remains unchanged
Integration specs via MohistIntegrationFixture cover all three routes plus their 404 paths
tasks.output: AgentRefResolver shared helper, new agent-scoped list route handler, reshaped summary route handler, new transcript route handler, and integration specs.
tasks.notes: The summary route path is unchanged from #129; only the response body becomes additive. Do not overload the existing project-wide GET .../agent/sessions — the spec mandates a distinct agent-scoped route with an explicit {agentRef} path segment.

tasks.title: Issue and epic agent-session association read endpoints
tasks.description: Add GET /api/projects/{projectRef}/issues/{number}/agent-sessions and GET /api/projects/{projectRef}/epics/{epicRef}/agent-sessions querying generic sessions by (project-id, source-kind=agent-launch, agent-launch/issue-number | epic-number) labels via the T-001 indexed columns. Return a lightweight association list where each entry carries sessionId, agentId, agentName, status, createdAt, and a link back to the session summary route. Resolve {epicRef} by number-then-id mirroring the existing EpicRoutes inline resolver. Empty result returns 200 with []; the endpoints are read-only and create no scope/mount/supervisor/ownership/lifecycle.
acceptanceCriteria: The issue endpoint returns the generic sessions referencing that issue via the mohist.io/agent-launch/issue-number label
The epic endpoint returns the generic sessions referencing that epic via the mohist.io/agent-launch/epic-number label
Each association entry carries sessionId, agentId, agentName, status, createdAt, and a link back to the session summary route
An issue or epic with no associated sessions returns 200 with an empty list
The endpoints perform no writes and create no scope, mount, supervisor, ownership, or workflow lifecycle; they do not mutate the issue or epic
Integration specs cover both endpoints, the empty-list case, and the read-only invariant
tasks.output: Two new route handlers, a lightweight association DTO, and integration specs.
tasks.notes: The association is a pure read derived from labels the launcher already stamps — do not persist an explicit link table or add write-path obligations.

tasks.title: CLI mo agent session list/show/transcript verbs
tasks.description: Extend the existing BuildSession parent in MohistCliCommands.Agent.cs with three subcommands mirroring IssueCommands.BuildSession*: 'list <agent> [--status]' (ResolveAgentAsync client-side, then GET .../agents/{agentId}/sessions), 'show <sessionId>' (GET .../agent-sessions/{sessionId}), and 'transcript <sessionId>' (GET .../agent-sessions/{sessionId}/transcript). Add TableShape entries and TableRenderer rows: table-mode list renders one row per session (id, status, created, resolved model) with running/failed/ended distinction; table-mode show renders the enriched summary; table-mode transcript renders a summary (part count, first/last activity); json-mode prints the raw server payload. Existing mo agent session launch/followup/cancel verbs are untouched.
acceptanceCriteria: mo agent session list <agent> resolves the agentRef client-side, calls GET .../agents/{agentId}/sessions, renders one row per session in table mode and the raw payload in json mode, and honors --status

mo agent session show <sessionId> renders the agent identity, status, created/last-activity, resolved model, usage, failure category, tool counts, and context refs in table mode and the raw payload in json mode
mo agent session transcript <sessionId> renders a summary (part count, first/last activity) in table mode and the full transcript in json mode, consistent with mo issue session transcript
A 404 from the server prints the server-provided error and exits non-zero with no silent success
The existing mo agent session launch/followup/cancel verbs and the mo issue session show/transcript verbs remain unchanged
CLI specs cover all three verbs, both output modes, the --status flag, and the error path
tasks.output: Extended MohistCliCommands.Agent.cs BuildSession, new TableShape/TableRenderer entries, and CLI specs.
tasks.notes: Reuse the existing CLI ResolveAgentAsync for agentRef resolution on the client side; the server-side AgentRefResolver (T-005) is the authoritative implementation.
